author: blu
body: The Location effect is the right to know where the machine is. It is a bare marker here, the way Microphone and Network are: the operations that use it -- locate and altitude -- are not declared in this chapter.

author: blu
body: This machine has no GPS receiver and no seam where one could be read, so the honest arrangement is that the foreword declares the RIGHT and something else supplies the answer. A chapter that wants the operations cites Foreword chapter LocationStub, and gets fixed constants that say in their own names that they are fixed. A chapter that does not gets CDX3002 on the name -- the truth: it asked for something it did not bring.
